cases.question: How do I make Le Tourin garlic soup?

response.answer: To make Le Tourin (Garlic Soup) for 2 servings in about 30 minutes: brown 10–12 chopped garlic cloves in 1 tablespoon olive oil in a frying pan. Add 1 tablespoon flour, mix well, and cook a few minutes to remove the floury taste. Gradually stir in 4 cups water, or as needed, and cook for 10 minutes. Beat the egg white in a small bowl, gradually whisk in a ladleful of the soup, then stir the mixture back into the pot. Combine the egg yolk, pepper and 1 teaspoon vinegar in a small bowl, temper the yolks with a ladleful of soup, then remove the soup from the heat and stir in the yolk mixture. Season to taste with salt. Place thin slices of bread in each bowl, pour the soup on top, and serve hot. The ingredient list comes from the source page and may be incomplete. Optionally, an equal mixture of chopped onions and garlic can be used.

cases.question: What's the method for pasta carbonara?

response.answer: The method for Spaghetti alla Carbonara is: 1) Dice the guanciale or pancetta into 2.5 cm (1-inch) pieces. 2) Bring a big pot of water to a boil and add salt to taste when it begins to simmer. 3) Cook the spaghetti until al dente, drain it, reserving 1 cup of water. 4) While the spaghetti cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; when hot, add the pancetta and cook about 10 minutes over a low flame until it has rendered most of its fat but is still chewy and barely browned. 5) In a bowl, slowly whisk about ½ cup of the pasta water into the egg yolks, add the grated cheese and mix thoroughly with a fork. 6) Strain the spaghetti and transfer it immediately to the skillet with the pancetta, toss, and turn off the heat. 7) Add the egg and cheese mixture to the pasta while stirring in the remaining pasta water to help thin the sauce and create an emulsion. 8) Add the pepper and toss to coat the pasta. The ingredient list comes from the source page and may be incomplete. A second recipe, Carbonara Pasta, is a variant that instead combines cooled fried pancetta and yolks in a bowl with the drained hot pasta, adding lemon zest and thyme.

The Spaghetti alla Carbonara recipe makes it by dicing guanciale or pancetta and bringing a big pot of salted water to a boil. Transfer the spaghetti immediately to the skillet, toss, and turn off the heat. Add the egg and cheese mixture while stirring in the remaining pasta water to thin the sauce and create an emulsion. Finally add the pepper and toss to coat the pasta. The Carbonara Pasta recipe is a variant that cooks the pancetta in a dry pan, combines it with the egg yolks, lemon zest and thyme off the heat, and tosses in the drained pasta. Two of the provided recipes are carbonara dishes. Spaghetti alla Carbonara (the more traditional version) is made by dicing guanciale or pancetta and cooking it in olive oil until it has rendered most of its fat but is still chewy; cooking the spaghetti until al dente and reserving about 1 cup of the pasta water; whisking about ½ cup of the pasta water into 5 egg yolks, then mixing in the grated Pecorino Romano and Parmigiano-Reggiano with a fork; transferring the drained spaghetti to the skillet and turning off the heat; adding the egg and cheese mixture while stirring in the remaining pasta water to create an emulsion; and finally adding the pepper and tossing to coat. The Carbonara Pasta recipe is a simpler variant: fry cubed pancetta in a dry pan until crispy and let it cool, combine it with egg yolks, salt, generous pepper, lemon zest, thyme and a little Parmigiano in a large bowl, then toss in the drained hot pasta, mix with a wooden spoon and serve immediately with extra Parmigiano on top.
